item.title: Can a Jacobian Lens Detect SAE Steering?
item.description: A prospectively frozen Llama 3.3 70B experiment asks whether SAE steering leaves a detectable downstream fingerprint in Jacobian-lens space. A preregistered follow-up adds semantic hard negatives, same-subfamily comparators, a 14-reader capacity ladder, and a failed replay gate that makes its endpoint results exploratory.
